title: Avro reads and prints defaults across union branch orders
summary: The integer after a null branch changed from Java null and an IDL null initializer to Integer(1) and the literal 1. With the array default [1], both pins threw AvroRuntimeException from the field getter and the IDL writer when the int branch came first.

change.description: Both pins should report a present default. Before, expect Java null and an IDL null initializer as reported for the generator. After, expect `Integer(1)` and an unquoted integer literal 1.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.
